guide_q: how does proof of work stop a double-spend?
note: guide_q / agent / root: questions the page test asks the guide and one agent; chapter-specific, so the test can check that the guide hands over to the right agent. The Consensus agent covers six concepts of the ontology at version 1.2.0 and four of them have an executed example (proof of work, the double-spend, mining and the difficulty adjustment), so a follow-up asking for an example can be answered, and it is not the largest agent (Computing with 13 concepts, Transfer with 11 and Cryptography with 9 are larger), which the test uses for its earlier questions. The three remaining switches say what SEN0401 does not (yet) have, so the checks that need it are skipped and listed rather than failed: corpus_kinds = the kinds of passage the agents search (no textbook or course ontology); course_outcomes = a course ontology with LO-n outcomes; code_layers = concept examples that are Python programs (ontology graph syntax and behaviour layers). bank_complete is no longer set to false: question_bank_v1_1_0.json has an item for each of the 117 concepts, two for each of the 42 concepts with a worked example, and question_bank_check_v1_2_0.py reports PASS. The corpus_kinds switch now lists book as well: the page embeds the ontology of its own chapter of Mastering Bitcoin, 3rd edition (mastering-bitcoin-3e, at a pinned commit), so the agents really do rank over book passages and the check that counts the kinds must expect one. course_outcomes stays false until SEN0401's own course-level ontologies exist; when they do, the corpus gains a course kind too and this switch is bumped again. | 1.3.0: the course-level ontologies (profile, outcomes, textbook part, material register) now exist, so corpus.course is no longer empty: corpus_kinds gains course and course_outcomes is true. course_q/course_lo name the question the course check asks and the outcome it must retrieve, because SEN0414 asked about choosing libraries, which is not an outcome of this course. | 1.4.0: code_layers is true: template 9.36.0 feeds the executed examples (n.io.code, 42 concepts in this chapter) to the syntax and behaviour extractor, so the ontology graph draws all three layers and the three-layer checks run. | 1.5.0: corpus_kinds gains standard: since page build 4.14.0 the page embeds the CME narrative-to-diagram mapping (two Turtle files, kind standard), which the agents' knowledge graph indexes like every other block.
